title: The score improved. The contradiction stayed.

scope.benchmark: Small synthetic arithmetic and evidence benchmark; fictional cases only.
scope.generalization: Descriptive results for these authored cases; not an estimate of general model performance.
scope.independence_note: The comparison unit is the case. Repetitions are repeated runs on each case, not additional independent cases.

association.csv_grain: One row per study, case, prompt edition, and repetition.

study.original: Eight cases used in the initial seed-versus-expanded comparison.
study.new_cases: Eight newly frozen cases used to compare seed, expanded, and expanded-with-checks editions.

definitions.case: One authored scenario containing three claims.
definitions.repetition: One run of a prompt edition on a case; each edition was run twice per case.
definitions.score: For each of three claims: 2 points for a correct verdict; 1 point for sufficient evidence when the verdict is correct; and 1 point for a correct numeric answer or an appropriate null. Maximum 4 points per claim and 12 per case run.
definitions.correct_numeric_or_null: Count of claims whose numeric field was correct or whose null was justified.
definitions.contradiction_diagnostic: Blinded review of the first numerically identifiable claim from each case in repetition 1; a response was flagged when its explanation and submitted answer conflicted.

same_case_comparisons.win_loss_interpretation: Counts describe the subject edition relative to the comparator edition.
